name: The Poor
overview: Scripture emphasizes the blessedness and righteousness of showing mercy and generosity toward the poor. Those who honor God demonstrate compassion by giving to and caring for the poor, receiving blessings in return, as giving is likened to lending to the Lord Himself. Conversely, despising or oppressing the poor is condemned, revealing a disregard for God’s authority. The righteous actively consider the needs of the poor, reflecting Christ-centered service and love.
